text:
leo.sales: Heads-up — BluPeak (enterprise) wants 99.99% uptime + p95 <= 50ms for the embeddings endpoint in eu-west. They're asking for contract language and a routing/escalation plan. Link to contract snippet: https://files.internal/blupeak/attachment.pdf
priya.support: Thanks — can you paste the exact clause they want? is this for hosted API or dedicated?
leo.sales: Hosted API initially; clause says: "Vendor shall maintain 99.99% availability for embeddings endpoints with p95 latency <= 50ms measured at the ingress edge for eu-west. Credits if breached." They want signed SLA by EOW.
jamal.eng: 50ms p95 for embeddings on hosted infra is tight for long sequences. Need model details (model size, seq len distribution, batch size). Also which replicas / region isolation?
leo.sales: BluPeak uses small embeddings (max 128 tokens), high QPS (bursty). Happy to share traffic sample.
sofia.sre: High-level options: 1) Dedicated pool pinned to eu-west with reserved GPUs (predictable latency) 2) Multi-zone failover + regional routing with warming and KV prefix caching 3) Hybrid: dedicated warm pool + shared overflow. Tradeoffs: cost and provisioning time.
sofia.sre: Also need observability hooks — per-tenant latency SLO dashboards, synthetic checks, and automated oncall paging if SLO crosses threshold.
maria.prod: Proposed product acceptance criteria for roadmap ticket: - Config knob to opt into "enterprise SLO" per customer - Automated canary and synthetic p95 tests in eu-west - Rollout path: canary -> staged -> full with automatic rollback policy - Billing impact surfaced in console and pricing sheet
maria.prod: Please avoid committing 99.99 until engineering confirms feasibility. Let's capture as "enterprise-slo-blupeak" intake and prioritize during next planning.
oliver.security: Any data residency / logging constraints? BluPeak is EU-regulated, so keys and logs must stay in-region and access controls audited. We should surface this to Legal.
priya.support: Filed customer support intake: ticket #78912. Adding extracts and traffic sample. Assigning to maria.prod for product triage.
intake-bot: New intake created: TKT-2026-78912 | enterprise-slo-blupeak | priority: high | owner: maria.prod. Link: https://redwood.internal/intake/TKT-2026-78912
jamal.eng: Early feasibility notes: - For small embeddings on A100-equivalent, p95=50ms is possible with dedicated pool + KV caching and small batch windows. - Must limit burst to avoid queueing; suggest quota + burst policy and circuit breaker.
sofia.sre: Escalation routing: page oncall-sre (pagerduty) for SLO breaches; create a special #sla-escalations channel where legal/sales/product get notified on incidents. Add runbook: immediate notify sales+legal+customer-ops, and open incident on status page.
maria.prod: Scope negotiation options to present to BluPeak: A) 99.99% uptime + 50ms p95 in eu-west for dedicated pool at +X% price premium B) 99.95% uptime with p95 <= 80ms on hosted tier (no price change) C) 99.99% but on Dedicated + warm caching + monthly commit. Need numbers from finance for premium.
leo.sales: I'll propose B as fallback and ask if they can accept dedicated if price agreed. Need final wording for contract.
oliver.security: I'll loop in legal and sentry for in-region KMS requirements.
priya.support: Next steps owner list: maria.prod (triage + roadmap entry), jamal.eng (feasibility + perf numbers), sofia.sre (oncall/runbook + infra options), oliver.security (legal/data residency), leo.sales (customer negotiation).
maria.prod: Agreed. Please add short acceptance tests to the intake: synthetic p95 < 50ms for 7/7 days in eu-west on canary, documented rollback criteria, and confirmed pricing.
leo.sales: Thanks — I'll update BluPeak and push contract draft.
sofia.sre: Tagging for follow-up: #sla-escalations, oncall-sre, legal.
intake-bot: TKT-2026-78912 updated: jamal.eng added feasibility notes.
leo.sales: Closing loop here for now. Will post contract draft once available. :thumbsup:
